question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Extent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The sentence is: "Social status and power determine the ___2 to which people can insulate themselves from environmental crises or overcome them."
 
• We need a word that fits the phrase "the ____ to which," indicating the degree or measure.
